CREATE TABLE ER (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_ER PRIMARY KEY, pad TEXT(120), zf LONG, zm LONG, zl LONG, zp LONG, zq LONG, tx TEXT(10), tq TEXT(10), ov LONG)

INSERT INTO ER (id, pad, zf, zm, zl, zp, zq, tx, tq, ov) SELECT n, Space(100), IIf(n = 3, 0, 1), IIf(n = 100, 0, 1), IIf(n = 240, 0, 1), IIf(n = 50 Or n = 150, 0, 1), IIf(n = 80, 0, 1), IIf(n = 60, 'x', '1'), IIf(n = 80, 'x', '1'), IIf(n = 150, 100000, 1) FROM NUM WHERE n <= 240 ORDER BY n
CREATE TABLE OT5 (pk LONG, k LONG, ins LONG, s TEXT(10))

CREATE TABLE OT4 (pk LONG CONSTRAINT PK_OT4 PRIMARY KEY, k LONG, ins LONG, s TEXT(10))
CREATE INDEX IX_OT3_K ON OT3 (k)
CREATE INDEX IX_OT4_KI ON OT4 (k, ins DESC)
